points.quote: `defineBlockSchema({ flavour, props, metadata, toModel })` declares the block. `flavour` is a namespaced string such as `'affine:callout'`... `metadata` holds `version`, `role`
`metadata` holds ... the `parent` and `children` flavour whitelists, which constrain where the block can sit in the tree.
`class CalloutBlockModel extends BlockModel<CalloutProps>` is the model class. ... `toModel: () => new CalloutBlockModel()` builds the model.

`CalloutBlockComponent extends CaptionedBlockComponent<CalloutBlockModel>`. This is a Lit element... `BlockViewExtension('affine:callout', literal`affine-callout`)` maps the flavour to a static Lit tag.

`CalloutStoreExtension extends StoreExtensionProvider` ... `CalloutViewExtension extends ViewExtensionProvider` ... Both providers are listed in the aggregate lists in `blocksuite/affine/all/src/extensions/store.ts` and `view.ts`.
`effect()` calls `effects()` to define the custom elements.
